# AImHighAI

> AImHighAI is an AI lead generation and outreach platform for agencies and marketers who sell to local service businesses. It finds businesses on Google Maps, scores the gaps in their online presence, matches each to the paid offer it is most likely to buy, writes personalized outreach, and bills one-time and monthly plans through Stripe.

## How it works

1. The user picks a niche and a city (for example "plumbers in Hattiesburg, MS").
2. AImHighAI searches Google Maps and returns real businesses with phone number, website, rating, review count and opening hours, skipping businesses already in the pipeline.
3. Each lead is scored 0–99 on real gaps: no website, a free page-builder site, few reviews, a low rating, or no phone.
4. Each lead is matched to one offer:
   - No website or a free site → website build ($497 setup + $49/month care)
   - Real site but under 20 reviews or under 4 stars → review growth plan ($197/month)
   - Healthy reviews and 24-hour service → missed-call text-back ($197/month)
   - 50+ reviews and a solid rating → Google profile and local SEO management ($497/month)
   Prices are editable.
5. AI writes outreach that cites the lead's own details. Nothing is sent until the user marks the lead verified.
6. When a lead agrees, AImHighAI bills a Stripe invoice or starts a monthly Stripe subscription, with any setup fee on the first invoice.

## Also included

- Intent discovery: finds public posts where people ask for help with a problem the user's offer solves, and turns them into warm leads with the original context.
- Free preview websites and audit reports generated for each lead.
- Affiliate referral tracking.

## Who it is for

Agencies, freelancers and marketers selling websites, reputation management, call handling or local SEO to plumbers, HVAC companies, roofers, lawyers, dentists and other local service businesses.
